verification.initial_archive_verifier: Rejected the OCI image-index ID because it expected a legacy configuration ID. Export and teardown had already succeeded; the original operation and archive were retained.
verification.followup: A separate offline verifier followed the original index through manifests, config and compressed blobs, checked every referenced digest and size, and checked all uncompressed filesystem layer digests against the live image inspection. No second VM boot or export was needed.

limits: This verifies the existing runtime image and a private portable export, not a new Docker engine import, source image build, native gameplay, save/reload or portable-owner acceptance.
The original guest is still below its unchanged game admission floor. No frozen trial may be launched there against the known shortage.
The source context remains immutable. A new native acceptance must have its own source/image/runtime declaration and identity; it cannot relabel Astra r2 or either Sol failure.
The archive may contain restricted game assets and historical private build material. It remains private and must not be redistributed as a public installation package.
The external project copy is not proof of an independent backup or restore.

Next verify a separate clean local runtime and import, then construct the source-bound image and exercise native fresh/continuation acceptance with mandatory teardown. Do not resize or delete the retained original VM/evidence.
Remaining full source review, merged delivery and unfinished declared gameplay comparisons are still open.
